content.label:
I really love your idea and this app! This application can help my daily productivity and reduce my typing time because I can now write any message, short or long, using my speech.

Recently, I saw that you support more than 10 languages. I would really like to ask you to add the Burmese language as well. Since I am from Myanmar, I would love to be able to type my paragraphs or text in my mother tongue, Burmese.

Thank you very much! 😊
